summary: Fixed server-variable env var in config.go to read ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID instead of the generator-derived ALGOLIA_APP_ID for {appId} host substitution.
reason: The generator derived the template var env name from the server variable name (appId -> ALGOLIA_APP_ID), but Algolia's canonical env var is ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID; without the fix every request hit a literal 'ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID.algolia.net' host.
validated_outcome: doctor reports OK API: reachable with ALGOLIA_APPLICATION_ID set; live dogfood 226/226 passed.
